notes.title: Early Access
notes.content:
Hello fellow Beasts,

Today we have a special announcement for all of you. BattleBeasts will be available as Early Access Release on Steam on May 11th. The current price is set to be $ 5. Add the game to your wish list if you don't want to miss it. Any other news will be posted here or in the #patch-notes channel.  If we have to postpone the start or the price changes, we will announce it here. Feel free to ask any questions in the #general channel. 

[h3]What is Early Access?[/h3]
Early Acces is an early version of the game far from being the finished release. This means that there isn't as much content as in a finished game release. You also might experience bad performance, since it isn't perfectly optimized, and will have a lot of bugs. 

[h3]What do we expect from the Playerbase?[/h3]
Our Players should understand that sometimes the game will have bugs, lag, and other early access issues. We would greatly benefit from the people who decide to join early access, to report the bugs on our Discord Server in the Channel regarding bug reports.

For more information visit the store page and read carefully through the Early Access part.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/830580/BattleBeasts/

notes.title: Keys for July
notes.content:
Hello fellow Beasts,

It’s time again. We are giving out more[b] free [/b]keys. If you want to obtain a key you need to send us an E-Mail to: [b]battlebeastskeys@gmail.com[/b]

Tell us why you are qualified to be one of the early testers for the BattleBeasts [b]Pre-Alpha tests. [/b]

[h1]What exactly are qualifications?[/h1]

You are qualified to be one of the testers if you have already participated in other Alpha or Beta tests for games. Additionally, if you have a high playtime in similar game genres (Survival Games or Shooters). We also accept BattleBeasts related Art (Paper or Digital).

If you have more questions visit the[b] [url=https://discord.gg/MhYSry2]Official Discord Server[/url]. [/b]
 
[b][i]Disclaimer: The Art won’t be accepted if it’s unrelated to BattleBeasts, stolen from somewhere or done in a few minutes within paint and looks horrible. Also sending multiple E-Mails and just begging for a key will also be rejected (Like everyone who just say things like “Give key” or “Key please”). Also asking for keys in the comments won’t get you any. Adding a link to your Steam profile can help us see your play times for similar games. (Not necessary!).[/i] [/b]

Best Regards
BattleBeasts Team

notes.title: Pre-Alpha 4.0, Indiegogo, and current plans
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone. Today is a very big announcement. It has been a long time since any tests have been made, due to financial and time restrictions. To solve this, the official indiegogo for BattleBeasts has launched.  https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/battlebeasts#/ .[/b]

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32551679/c1d10a55850757d475594c2a015dcbae2e00f7d0.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32551679/75404ebce5c02b73b14649ea829086a9c099c991.png[/img][/url]

[h1]What does this mean?[/h1]

This means now that the Dev team is able to get support, they can dedicate more time to the games development. It also determines just how far the development can go at this stage. To kick off with this, we are moving into Pre-Alpha Version 4.0 series. 

[i][b]Version Notes:[/b]
- New Gun rework
   - New gun skins in 1st person.
   - Smoother shooting/usage.
   - New sounds.

- New resources
   - Crystals, purple and green.
   - New sounds.

- New structures
   - Redid starting zone.
   - Added new structures on the map.

- Safe zone added.
- Map updated.
- Chat box improved.
- Other small bug fixes.
- Indiegogo campaign released with tiers.
- Server changes.[/i]

This is needed to create a "baseline" of what needs to be improved first, but also what you the players want to see first. It has been a while since a test, so there may be some returning bugs, but now that there is enough support to continue, we need a nice new start. 

[h1]What about Keys?[/h1]

You will need to purchase one through indiegogo, link above. Currently, there are 3 different tier options. The lowest will grant you Alpha and Beta Access when it moves into those stages. The keys will be sent when it moves to those stages to you, and all items will be given in the package for final launch. Same goes for the second, and highest tier. For those who get them, you will get your Pre-Alpha access before the next test, or as soon as you purchase it if 4.0 has already begun. 

[i][u]If you already have a current free Pre-Alpha key: [/u][/i]

You WILL continue to get free access to Pre-Alpha, Alpha, and Beta. We will not remove your access since it was already given to you a long time ago. However, to get the extra perks off of indiegogo you will still need to purchase the tiers accordingly. 

[b]Test 4.0: the test will be THIS Saturday, 2/23/18, at 18:00 (GMT + 3). This will be a short 24 hour test, to get a baseline, and many more longer tests coming soon after.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32551679/ea14b1ddbcf6d0871a5c1886eb62d6b74d2ce83e.jpg[/img]

Thank you!

notes.title: Pre-Alpha v3.2 Test date and Free Key rework
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32551679/5dd3ca82ee8896cd0478a758c4055b02abb59ec4.png[/img]

Hello everyone, first of all thank you for your patience. With limited time and people, and less than a year so far in development from scratch, the game has a long way to go. But we are happy to announce...

[b]Pre- Alpha versiom 3.2 test is finally here, December 16th at 16:00 GMT +3, and will be up for 48 hours, until December 18th 16:00 GMT +3.[/b] 

[u]Version 3.2 Update:[/u]

- Guns re-added.
- Some building bugs fixed.
- Spawns randomized.
- UI features upgraded.
- New creature added to the world.
- Audio fixes. 
- Deer now drop meat and can be killed.
- New structures added to the world. 
- Text and Menu bugs fixed.
- New resource to gather.
- New game lore.

[b]New Key Method[/b]

Pre-Alpha keys are also being changed. No more requests for free Pre-Alpha keys will be taken 24 hours prior to the test. This means all requests after December 15th 16:00 GMT +3 will[b] not [/b]be responded to.

However, all requests BEFORE that time, will be given a key. Even if you have not received your key by the cut off time, as long as the request is before December 15th 16:09 GMT +3 , you will get your key.

All Pre-Alpha keys will continue working for all pre-alpha tests. You do not need to request another one if you have had one for previous tests or gotten one recently. All requests will be answered by the tests time. 

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32551679/a746e114b1d6af937374d27b0d767c8ba5ccff2b.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32551679/8bc25ee80aed7b85656e794284e20eb782f92648.png[/img][/url]

The future of how keys will be given is in the works and will be announced when we have it set up and know more. Thank you, and enjoy!

notes.title: New version of BB
notes.content:
We are happy to announce the latest news of BattleBeasts.
New vision of BB is survival-sandbox, the events take place in the island of square 8*8 km.
As a result of extraordinary events prisoners have escaped of prison
Using space rescue capsules, prisoners enter an island with an abandoned space base on the planet, where they have to survive, having at their arsenal a minimum of tools.
And teaming will give more chances for survival.
BattleBeasts is an sandbox-shooter with open world, where foxes, raccoons, tigers, wolfs and other sentient beasts of the galaxy fight for survival.
Travel, explore the locations, fight with NPC-enemies and each other. In the world of BattleBeasts you are free to go in any direction, to study all the corners of the game world, build your fortifications and bases, choose your style of survival.
What's new in alpha 3.0:
• We removed classes and abilities, in order to remove the imbalance among the players.
• Redesigned the graphics so that all players could play without affecting the graphics on the balance of the game.
• Your accounts will become universal for all our servers, and characters will remain assigned to your account.
• Balancing gaming servers and running cards will keep the server full.
• The game balance system will not allow top players to dominate the newcomers.
• The system of gaining experience by the player became more saturated by reducing the time for the drawing of objects. The objects themselves became several times larger.
• New managed bots and drones are introduced into the game balance, drawings can be studied, build their own bots and give them tasks.
• Hover is the only vehicle.
